editorial:
Imagine being a horse racer who has hit rock bottom. That is exactly where you find Bjarte, a chubby guy who just cannot catch a break. He used to be in the game, but now he is stuck with bad horses and a mountain of debt. When the people he owes money to start getting scary, he decides to take a shortcut into the world of crime. The vibe is lighthearted and chaotic, feeling like one of those movies where everything that can go wrong actually does. You will find yourself rooting for Bjarte even though he makes some pretty terrible decisions along the way.

What really makes this work is the chemistry between the characters and the silly situations they land in. The pacing stays quick, especially when the plot shifts from a failed doping scheme to a full-on horse kidnapping. While some of the jokes are a bit simple, the physical comedy is great. If you are looking for a stress-free movie, you should definitely give this one a try. You can rent it on Apple TV for a quick movie night, or if you really love the film, you can add the 4K Blu-ray to your physical collection to see the horse racing scenes in crisp detail.
endingExplained: Everything comes to a head when Bjarte has to deal with the fallout of stealing Berlusconi. After a series of wild mishaps and close calls with the law, Bjarte finally manages to make things right. He learns that cheating and crime were never the answer to his money problems. The movie wraps up with a funny twist where Bjarte finds a way to get back into the racing world honestly, finally finding success without the crime.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves quirky comedies about losers winning big.
